content.title: Aegon (ENXTAM:AGN) Is Down 9.6% After Announcing US Move, Transamerica Rebrand And UK Review
content.summary: Aegon has announced a multi‑year overhaul that includes moving its head office and legal domicile to the US by 2028, rebranding the holding company as Transamerica, shifting to US GAAP reporting, launching a €400 million share buyback for 2026, and beginning a review of its UK operations that could result in a sale.
